groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.802% and the 10Y at 5.099%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -2.64% over five sessions and -4.73% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -0.35% at about $92.81, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-38/100, 75% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, falling oil on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.099%, Nasdaq breadth is weak, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
